joaquinmulet-artificial-general-research.description: AGR: Artificial General Research — autonomous iterative optimization framework for Claude Code. Generalizes Karpathy's autoresearch to any measurable problem with variance-aware acceptance, correctness verification, and fresh-context-per-iteration (Ralph Loop). Use when setting up autoresearch, creating optimization loops, or autonomous research. Triggers on: autoresearch, AGR, auto research, optimization loop, auto optimize, artificial general research.
